title: Iridium Lip Cuff
shoot_prompt: A high-fashion commercial luxury jewelry 3x3 contact sheet featuring the Iridium Lip Cuff. Canvas layout: Exactly 9 vertical 3:4 portrait vignette frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, edge-to-edge full bleed, separated by crisp 1.5px solid white #FFFFFF borders. Studio Environment: Standardized neutral cyclorama backdrop in matte grey #EFEFEF, clean minimal stone surface with subtle soft contact shadows. Coherent 5500K softbox illumination, Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format clarity, f/8 depth of field. Product Specifics: Minimalist sculptural non-piercing lip cuff in rhodium-plated 925 sterling silver, fluid ergonomic U-curve with comfort-beveled tips. Mode: SINGLE_ITEM. Row 1 (Packshot Hero): Cell 1 (Front Hero): Frontal eye-level packshot of the single Iridium cuff resting upright on stone base, showcasing liquid metallic reflections and pure minimalist curve. Cell 2 (3/4 Perspective): Three-quarter angle emphasizing continuous tapered thickness and mirror shine. Cell 3 (Side Profile): Lateral 90-degree profile showing the precision tension gap designed for non-pierced lip wear. Row 2 (Technical Details): Cell 4 (Overhead Flat Lay): Direct top-down flat lay on #EFEFEF surface showing the symmetric U-profile of the cuff. Cell 5 (Optical Macro): Extreme macro view capturing the microscopic rhodium mirror finish and comfort-rounded inner edges. Cell 6 (Mechanical Detail): Technical focus on the subtle hallmark stamp (925) and tension retention curve. Row 3 (Editorial On-Model Context): Cell 7 (Editorial Portrait): High-fashion editorial beauty portrait of model wearing the silver Iridium cuff clipped securely to the center of the lower lip. Cell 8 (Intimate Micro-Crop): Ultra-tight macro crop on the lips and chin, displaying the gleaming silver hugging the natural vermilion border of the lower lip with soft skin texture. Cell 9 (Dynamic Lifestyle): 3/4 editorial angle showing subtle head tilt and dramatic light play on the chrome curve. Strict Invariant: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, NO GRAPHICS. Pure raw commercial photography only.
